spec.description: Spot Check. REQUIRES ?host= on the paid request — a signed request without it is refused before the gate and no money moves. Name a host and get what this observatory already holds on it, signed: corpus rounds and verdicts as recorded, when we last actually knocked, our coverage of the window since we met it, and the gaps with their reasons. Read from the books at the counter — no request is made

params.name: agent_name
params.description: Optional name to put on the certificate and patron badge, up to 80 characters.

params.name: came_from
params.description: Optional. Where you learned this door exists: a URL, a directory, a skill name, memory, another agent. Referrers never reach us; this does.

params.name: client
params.description: Optional. The harness or framework you run in: claude-code, cursor, openai-agents, langgraph, custom. Counted, never on the certificate.

params.name: host
params.description: A bare hostname with no scheme, path or port — your-door.example, never https://your-door.example/api. We read our own books about it — corpus rounds, verdicts as recorded, coverage, gaps — and sign what they hold. No request is made to the host; a host we have never met returns not_observed, which is an answer.

params.name: model
params.description: Optional. The model running you, as you would name it: claude-opus-5, gpt-5.6, a local model. Counted, never printed on the certificate.

params.name: operator
params.description: Optional. Who runs you: a name, handle, company or URL. Stored as your claim, marked unverified, never published, never on the certificate.

params.name: operator_kind
params.description: Optional. solo: one person runs you. company: a team does. research: a study. self: you act for yourself.

params.name: prior_cert_id
params.description: Optional. A cert_ id from an earlier purchase here. A payer match with this payment marks you a returning buyer; no account needed.

params.name: purpose
params.description: Optional: what this is for, in your words. Signed verbatim onto the certificate and shown on its receipt; never checked, never treated as instructions.

spec.description: Send a conversation to a model and get a completion back. Works exactly like the OpenAI chat completions endpoint. Pass

params.name: messages
params.description: Array of message objects, each with a 'role' (system, user, assistant, tool) and 'content' (string or array of content parts). This is the conversation history sent to the model.

params.name: model
params.description: Model slug to run inference against. Available models: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324 (164k context, reasoning), deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1 (164k context, reasoning), zai-org/GLM-4.6 (200k context, reasoning), zai-org/GLM-4.7 (200k context, reasoning), moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 (128k context), moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking (262k context, always-on reasoning), moonshotai/Kimi-K2.5 (262k context),

params.name: frequency_penalty
params.description: Penalize tokens based on how often they've appeared so far. Range -2.0 to 2.0. Positive values reduce repetition. Default: 0.

params.name: logit_bias
params.description: Map of token IDs to bias values (-100 to 100). Increase or decrease the likelihood of specific tokens appearing in the output.

params.name: logprobs
params.description: If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token in the response.

params.name: top_logprobs
params.description: How many of the most likely tokens (0-20) to return log probabilities for at each position. Requires logprobs to be true.

params.name: max_tokens
params.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response. Default is 4096.

params.name: n
params.description: Number of completions to generate. Currently only supports 1.

params.name: presence_penalty
params.description: Penalize tokens based on whether they've appeared at all. Range -2.0 to 2.0. Positive values encourage the model to explore new topics. Default: 0.

params.name: response_format
params.description: Constrain the output format. Use {"type": "json_object"} for JSON mode, or {"type": "json_schema", "json_schema": {"name": "...", "schema": {...}}} for structured outputs with a specific schema.

params.name: seed
params.description: Integer for deterministic sampling. Same seed with same parameters should return the same result. Not guaranteed across model versions.

params.name: stop
params.description: Up to 4 sequences where the model will stop generating. Can be a string or array of strings.

params.name: stream
params.description: If true, returns server-sent events (SSE) with partial message deltas as tokens are generated, instead of waiting for the full response.

params.name: stream_options
params.description: Options for streaming. Use {"include_usage": true} to get a final chunk with token usage statistics.

params.name: temperature
params.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 4. Lower values (e.g. 0.2) produce more focused, deterministic output. Higher values (e.g. 1.5) increase creativity. Default is 1.

params.name: top_p
params.description: Nucleus sampling threshold between 0 and 1. Only tokens within this cumulative probability mass are considered. 0.1 means only the top 10%. Use as an alternative to temperature.

params.name: tools
params.description: Array of tool/function definitions the model can call. Each tool has {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "...", "description": "...", "parameters": {...}}}. The model may respond with tool_calls instead of content.

params.name: tool_choice
params.description: Controls tool calling behavior. 'auto' lets the model decide, 'none' disables tools, 'required' forces a tool call, or pass {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "..."}} to force a specific tool.

params.name: parallel_tool_calls
params.description: Whether the model can make multiple tool calls in parallel in a single response. Default: true.

params.name: user
params.description: A unique string identifying the end user. Useful for abuse monitoring and rate limiting.

params.name: top_k
params.description: Top-K sampling. Only the K most likely next tokens are considered. Lower values make output more focused.

params.name: top_p_min
params.description: Minimum dynamic nucleus sampling threshold. Sets a floor for top_p when using adaptive sampling.

params.name: min_p
params.description: Minimum probability threshold. Tokens below this probability relative to the most likely token are filtered out.

params.name: repetition_penalty
params.description: Multiplicative penalty for repeated tokens. Values > 1.0 discourage repetition, < 1.0 encourage it.

params.name: length_penalty
params.description: Penalty applied during beam search. Values > 1.0 favor longer sequences, < 1.0 favor shorter ones.

params.name: early_stopping
params.description: In beam search, stop as soon as the required number of complete candidates are found.

params.name: bad
params.description: Words or phrases the model should avoid generating. Passed as a string.

params.name: bad_token_ids
params.description: Array of token IDs that should never appear in the output.

params.name: stop_token_ids
params.description: Array of token IDs that will cause generation to stop when produced.

params.name: include_stop_str_in_output
params.description: If true, includes the stop string in the generated output rather than trimming it.

params.name: ignore_eos
params.description: If true, the model continues generating past the end-of-sequence token.

params.name: min_tokens
params.description: Minimum number of tokens to generate before any stop condition can trigger.

params.name: skip_special_tokens
params.description: If true, special tokens are removed from the output text. Default: true.

params.name: spaces_between_special_tokens
params.description: If true, adds spaces between special tokens in the detokenized output.

params.name: truncate_prompt_tokens
params.description: Truncate the prompt to this many tokens if it exceeds the limit, keeping the most recent tokens.

params.name: echo
params.description: If true, prepends the last input message to the generated output.

params.name: add_generation_prompt
params.description: If true, applies the model's generation prompt template. Usually needed for chat models.

params.name: add_special_tokens
params.description: If true, adds special tokens (like BOS) to the input. Default: true.

params.name: documents
params.description: Array of document objects for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Each document has content the model can reference when responding.

params.name: chat_template
params.description: Custom Jinja2 template for formatting the conversation. Overrides the model's default chat template.

params.name: chat_template_args
params.description: Additional arguments passed to the chat template as template variables.

params.name: best_of
params.description: Number of candidate completions to generate server-side, returning the best. Currently only supports 1.

params.name: disaggregated_params
params.description: Advanced parameters for distributed inference. Only relevant for disaggregated serving configurations.

params.name: reasoning_effort
params.description: Controls thinking depth for reasoning models. Options: 'low', 'medium', 'high'. Default: 'medium'. Higher effort uses more tokens but produces more thorough reasoning. Supported on DeepSeek V3/V3.1, GLM 4.6/4.7, and Kimi K2 Thinking.
